name: timestamp_jump__robot_clock
regression: Timestamp jump: a clock step on one host is detected per topic against its own receipt baseline and does not change any arbitration decision.
initial_conditions: Synthetic GO2 + HELIX run (6.5 s): /nav/cmd_vel at 20 Hz commands 0 m/s, then 0.15 m/s from t=2 s; HELIX hold published at 10 Hz, never asserted; odometry and lowstate at 20 Hz from the robot host, whose clock is 1.734 s ahead of the payload.
injected_fault: The robot host's clock steps 2.0 s forward at t=3.0 s (odometry and lowstate stamps).
